A '''pilot''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as part of an [[Hidden Path|anti-Imperial network]] on the [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]]. He prepared a [[starship]] to help refugees [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] escape, but when several [[Inquisitor]]s arrived with [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] in search of Kenobi, [[Tala Durith]] contacted him and told him that they had to move their timetable. At the end of the tunnel system, the pilot was [[Death|killed]] by the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] before Organa, who had continued on while Kenobi led the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces away and Tala later went to help him, arrived.<ref name="K 3" />
